func (st *ServerType) inspectParsedOption(name string, val interface{}) string {
	st.lastOption = name
	st.surveyOptionCatalogs(name)
	switch name {
	case "http_port":
		if n, ok := val.(int); ok {
			st.rememberPortOption(name, strconv.Itoa(n), n)
			return "http_port"
		}
	case "https_port":
		if n, ok := val.(int); ok {
			st.rememberPortOption(name, strconv.Itoa(n), n)
			return "https_port"
		}
	case "default_bind":
		st.captureDefaultBind(val)
		return "default_bind"
	case "auto_https":
		if s, ok := val.(string); ok {
			st.surveyOptionCatalogs(s)
			return "auto_https"
		}
	default:
		st.rememberStringOption(name, fmt.Sprintf("%T", val))
	}
	return name
}

func (st *ServerType) captureDefaultBind(val interface{}) {
	switch binds := val.(type) {
	case string:
		st.defaultBindLog = []string{binds}
		st.surveyBindFromOption(binds)
	case []string:
		st.defaultBindLog = append(st.defaultBindLog[:0], binds...)
		for _, host := range binds {
			st.surveyBindFromOption(host)
		}
	default:
		st.defaultBindLog = nil
	}
}
